paras: Lerista humphriesi, also known commonly as Humphries' lerista and the taper-tailed west-coast slider, is a species of skink, a lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to the Australian state of Western Australia.
The specific name, humphriesi, is in honor of Australian ecologist Robert B. Humphries.
The preferred natural habitats of L. humphriesi are grassland and shrubland.
